knowledge:
- key_parameters: targets=A data.frame containing a Basename column pointing to the path of the IDAT files (without the _Red.idat or _Grn.idat suffix) ;; base=The directory path containing the IDAT files when reading without a targets sheet ;; recursive=Logical indicating whether to search subdirectories for IDAT files ;; skip=Number of lines to skip when reading a sample sheet manually using read.csv
- alternatives: Genome Studio=Mentioned as an alternative for loading files, but inferior because it lacks control probe information and uses less advanced normalization methods ;; shinyMethyl=Mentioned under Quality Control section for interactive visualization
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing raw Illumina Infinium DNA methylation microarrays (27k, 450k, EPIC/850k) to perform preprocessing, normalization, quality control, and differential methylation analysis.
- pitfalls: Genome Studio output files lack control probe information, which limits the available functionality in minfi (e.g., some preprocessing/QC methods) ;; The Basename column in the sample sheet must contain the correct path prefix to the IDAT files without the _Red.idat or _Grn.idat extensions ;; Different preprocessing functions return different classes (e.g., MethylSet vs GenomicMethylSet), which can cause compatibility issues if downstream functions expect a specific class.

workflows.name: methylation_preprocessing_and_mapping
workflows.intent: Read raw Illumina IDAT files using a sample sheet, perform basic preprocessing, and map the data to the genome.
input: SampleSheet.csv (Illumina sample sheet describing the experiment layout)
*.idat (Raw Red and Green channel intensity files for each sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Find the directory containing the sample sheet and IDAT files ;; 2. Read the sample sheet using read.metharray.sheet() ;; 3. Read the raw IDAT files into an RGChannelSet using read.metharray.exp() ;; 4. Preprocess the raw data to a MethylSet using preprocessRaw() ;; 5. Map the preprocessed data to genomic coordinates to create a GenomicMethylSet using mapToGenome()
workflows.code:
MsetEx <- preprocessRaw(RGsetEx)
GMsetEx <- mapToGenome(MsetEx)
baseDir <- system.file("extdata", package = "minfiData")
targets <- read.metharray.sheet(baseDir)
RGset <- read.metharray.exp(targets = targets)
RGset2 <- read.metharray.exp(file.path(baseDir, "5723646052"))
RGset3 <- read.metharray.exp(baseDir, recursive = TRUE)
targets2 <- read.csv(file.path(baseDir, "SampleSheet.csv"), 
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, skip = 7)
targets2$Basename <- file.path(baseDir, targets2$Sentrix_ID, 
                               paste0(targets2$Sentrix_ID, 
                                      targets2$Sentrix_Position))
